explanation.headline: FDA's records show acetaminophen is not on the drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21

sentences.text: FDA's drug shortage list does not include acetaminophen as of 2026-10-21.
Our supply of acetaminophen 10 mg/mL 100 mL bags is labeled by Baxter Healthcare Corporation with NDC 36000-306-60.
Corvale East holds 497 bags with 26.9 days on hand at 18.5 bags per day.
Corvale Lakeside holds 37 bags with 8.8 days on hand at 4.2 bags per day.
The top-ranked option by rule is to transfer 22 bags from Corvale East to Corvale Lakeside, which would give Corvale East 27 days on hand after transfer and bring Corvale Lakeside to 14 days.
An alternative transfer of 22 bags from Corvale General would leave Corvale General with 16 days on hand and bring Corvale Lakeside to 14 days.
A third option is to buy from B. Braun Medical Inc., which is not on FDA's shortage list today.

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.
